h1: Epitalon (Epithalon) peptide: what the mouse, cell and Russian extract studies show, and what has never been tested in people
dek: A synthetic pineal tetrapeptide with a real animal literature and a famous telomerase claim. This page separates the synthetic peptide from the bovine extract it was modelled on, tabulates every dose a study gave, and says what the longevity use rests on: no randomized human trial and no human telomere measurement.

queries.heading: Routes: what the studies used
queries.boundary: Subcutaneous in the lifelong mouse studies, intranasal in rat brain and pineal studies, oral in one rat absorption study, intramuscular for the extract in the Russian cancer trial. No human study states a route for synthetic Epitalon.

queries.heading: Side effects: what is known, and the telomerase question
queries.boundary: No human study of Epitalon recorded adverse events. What exists is the lifelong mouse study, which its authors read as evidence of safety, and the theoretical concern that anything raising telomerase in cancer cells raises.

queries.heading: Does Epitalon help sleep?
queries.answer: No human study has measured sleep. The sleep reputation rests on the pineal origin of the sequence and on Russian studies in which the extract Epithalamin, and a related complex, Pineamin, raised night-time melatonin excretion in elderly people. Whether synthetic Epitalon does the same in people has not been tested.

queries.heading: What is Epitalon?
queries.answer: Epitalon (also spelled Epithalon; sequence Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly, AEDG) is a synthetic tetrapeptide designed by Vladimir Khavinson's group in St Petersburg from the amino-acid composition of Epithalamin, a bovine pineal extract used in Soviet and Russian medicine. It is studied for telomerase activation, melatonin restoration and lifespan in animals and cells; no randomized human trial of the peptide itself exists.

queries.heading: What people report outside the literature
queries.boundary: Forum reports are experiences, not evidence. The ten-day cycles people describe come from the Russian Epithalamin protocols, not from any study of the synthetic peptide.

queries.heading: What is the half-life of Epitalon?
queries.answer: Not measured in people. No pharmacokinetic study of Epitalon is indexed for any species in the ledger. In rats, intranasal doses changed cortical neuron firing within five to seven minutes, which says it acts quickly, not how long it lasts. Figures quoted online are guesses.

queries.heading: Can Epitalon be taken orally?
queries.answer: One rat study gave Epitalon by mouth and measured intestinal absorption of glucose and glycine, so the route has been used in an animal for a different question. No study has measured whether oral Epitalon reaches the blood or has any effect in people; a four-amino-acid peptide would be expected to be largely digested.

queries.heading: Epitalon vs Epithalamin, Pinealon, melatonin and DSIP
queries.boundary: Epitalon is the synthetic tetrapeptide; Epithalamin is the bovine pineal extract it was modelled on; Pinealon is its sibling tripeptide; melatonin is the hormone the extract was shown to restore. No study has compared them in people.

Does Epitalon cause or prevent cancer?
queries.answer: Both directions have animal data and neither has human data for the peptide. In 54 mice injected monthly for life, total tumour incidence did not change and leukaemia fell sixfold; in a rat colon-cancer model it slowed tumour cell proliferation. Against that, a 2025 cell study found it lengthened telomeres in breast-cancer lines through the ALT pathway, which is the mechanism cancers use to keep dividing. The one human trial is of the extract Epithalamin added to cervical-cancer treatment.

queries.heading: Does Epitalon make you look younger?
queries.answer: No study has measured skin, appearance or any visible marker of ageing in people. The anti-ageing claim rests on telomere lengthening in cell cultures, on a 13% extension of maximum lifespan in one mouse study that did not change mean lifespan, and on Russian reports about the extract Epithalamin.

information_gain: The only page that separates Epitalon, the synthetic tetrapeptide, from Epithalamin, the bovine pineal extract, and shows that every human result cited for Epitalon (melatonin restoration, the cervical-cancer trial, the coronary-disease rhythm study) is a result for the extract; that reports the lifelong mouse study in full, including that mean lifespan did not change, that total tumour incidence did not change, and that the 13% gain was in the last 10% of survivors; that states the 2025 finding that Epitalon lengthened telomeres in breast-cancer cells through the ALT pathway, the concern no dosing page raises; and that says no human study has measured telomere length or given the synthetic peptide at a stated dose.
serp_format_rewarded: Evidence explainer. Two PMC papers and Wikipedia rank above the fold, so a cited page that reads like a review, with the extract-versus-peptide distinction as its spine, fits.
